title: Power Pages: plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code edits traditional sites
summary: The roadmap details, download and upload controls, and documented coding-agent billing are supported. The licensing field should distinguish the existing Power Pages subscription from the unpublished plugin-specific price.

claims.claim: The planned plugin support creates and edits traditional non-SPA Power Pages sites using GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code.

claims.claim: Learn currently describes the plugin for modern SPA sites.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Microsoft warns that AI-generated code and configuration can be inaccurate.
claims.quote: Code and configuration generated by the AI coding agent can be inaccurate.

claims.claim: Learn advises reviewing, testing and validating generated content before approval or deployment.
claims.quote: Review, test, and validate all generated content before you approve or deploy it. Always review agent proposals before approving them.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Table permissions assigned to web roles control access to Dataverse data.
claims.quote: Table permissions assigned to web roles allow members of the web role to access data that's stored in Dataverse tables.

claims.claim: An incorrect permission or web-role change can widen anonymous access.
claims.quote: When the Anonymous users web role is granted access to a table, any user who visits the site can access the data in the table.

claims.claim: An incorrect permission or web-role change can widen authenticated users' access.
claims.quote: Table permissions assigned to web roles allow members of the web role to access data that's stored in Dataverse tables.

claims.claim: The workflow introduces third-party AI coding tools.
claims.quote: Anthropic's Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools.

claims.claim: Downloaded site metadata is stored on the developer machine.
claims.quote: Support for download/upload of website configuration data to/from the local file system

claims.claim: Downloaded site metadata can include configuration details.
claims.quote: When you download website content using Microsoft Power Platform CLI, the content is structured in YAML and HTML formats making it easy to customize

claims.claim: Power Platform Tools exposes Download and Upload under Explorer > Power Pages Actions > Active Sites > site (right-click).
claims.quote: Power Pages Actions is available in the pane titled Power Pages Actions in the Explorer sidebar of Visual Studio Code. ... Upload: Uploads local changes back to your environment. ... Download: Downloads the site content to a local folder for offline editing.

claims.claim: pac pages download accepts --path, --webSiteId and --modelVersion to download website content.
claims.quote: pac pages download --path "C:\portals" --webSiteId f88b70cc-580b-4f1a-87c3-41debefeb902 --modelVersion 2

claims.claim: pac pages upload accepts --path and --modelVersion to upload website content.
claims.quote: Upload Power Pages website content to current Dataverse environment. ... pac pages upload --path "C:\portals\starter-portal" --modelVersion 2

claims.claim: The plugin's CLI workflow uses the developer's authenticated environment session.
claims.quote: An authenticated PAC CLI session connected to your target environment. ... An Azure CLI session signed in to the same tenant.

claims.claim: Dataverse operations are constrained by the developer account's roles and access.
claims.quote: Your code will only be able to perform operations based on the privileges assigned to the user account through security roles or team membership.

claims.claim: No plugin-specific tenant admin switch is documented on the UI or API surface.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages coding agent plugin disable tenant setting Power Platform API pac admin PowerShell upload audit identifier. Read plugin guide, tenant-settings and list-tenantsettings; no plugin-specific switch found.

claims.claim: The plugin capability is user-opt-in.
claims.quote: Install the Power Pages plugin from the marketplace. ... Invoke each skill conversationally, either as a slash command or by describing what you want to do.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a plugin-specific price.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Pages plugin GitHub Copilot CLI Claude Code licensing price prerequisites; "Power Pages" "plugin" "price". Read plugin prerequisites and searched its full text; read Power Pages go-live/assign-licensing and licensing FAQ excerpts. No plugin-specific price found.

claims.claim: Feature-specific licensing is unknown.
claims.quote: As you work on projects and need to establish permanent sites that don't expire, you can apply Power Pages subscriptions and convert websites from trial to production.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Coding-agent costs depend on the provider and billing arrangement.
claims.quote: Claude models use Global Standard deployments with pay-per-token billing ... Without this variable, Claude Code uses the default Anthropic API.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: GitHub usage including GitHub Copilot can be billed through the Azure subscription linked to the GitHub organization.
claims.quote: GitHub usage is billed through the Azure subscription linked to your GitHub organization. ... All GitHub usage from that organization — including GitHub Copilot and GitHub Actions — flows to that subscription.

claims.claim: The documented Microsoft Foundry configuration for Claude Code requires a paid Azure subscription.
claims.quote: To use Claude models in Microsoft Foundry, you must have a paid Azure subscription with a billing account in a country or region where Anthropic offers the models for purchase.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; front matter: cost
claims.claim: Claude Code configured with Microsoft Foundry uses pay-per-token billing.
claims.quote: Claude models use Global Standard deployments with pay-per-token billing, so idle deployments don't incur charges.

claims.claim: The Power Pages CLI guidance supports keeping site configuration in source control.
claims.quote: You can now check in the website configuration to source control and move the website configuration to any environment using Microsoft Power Platform CLI.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a plugin-specific upload identifier in the admin center as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Pages" "plugin" "upload" "identifier". Read plugin guide, pac pages reference, tenant settings and Power Pages CLI guidance; no plugin-specific upload identifier found.
